rationale: The implementation uses multi-start gradient ascent with central differences for gradient estimation. It respects the budget by tracking every evaluation call. The algorithm starts from multiple points (including shared candidates if available) and performs bounded backtracking line search to handle local optima. The step size is adaptive, and the search terminates when the gradient norm is small or the budget is exhausted. The result is a JSON-serializable dict with the best parameters found, all observations, and an empty list for proposed improvements.
